query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN coconut_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN coconut_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as not_enriched,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN coconut_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as pct_enriched
FROM v3_molecules;
